context.requirement_text: REQ-204: SSRF validation for webhook target_url. 9 acceptance criteria: (1) non-https scheme rejection at create/2; (2) 5 explicit private-range rejections at create/2 (127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, 10.0.0.5, 172.16.0.5, 192.168.0.5); (3) legitimate https target succeeds at create/2; (4) deliver/3 DNS-rebinding test (hostname resolves to private IP at delivery time); (5) dispatch_http/3 no-redirect regression; (6) INV-9 added (already done); (7) moduledoc ranges (already done); (8) mix test passes; (9) no scope change.

task.description: Write tests for REQ-204 SSRF validation. Required test files: (1) test/letflow/webhooks/url_validator_test.exs -- unit tests for UrlValidator directly; (2) additions to test/letflow/webhooks_test.exs -- integration tests for create/2 and deliver/3 SSRF paths. See design §6 for the DNS injection hook mechanism. All 9 acceptance criteria must have test coverage.
acceptance_criteria: test/letflow/webhooks/url_validator_test.exs exists with unit tests for all range checks
AC1: create/2 with http:// scheme rejected with {:error, :target_url_not_allowed}
AC3: create/2 with legitimate https target succeeds
AC4: DNS rebinding test -- deliver/3 refuses when hostname resolves to private IP at delivery time
AC5: dispatch_http/3 does not auto-follow 3xx (no {autoredirect, true} in HTTPOptions)
Tests use the dns_resolver injection hook (validate/2) for unit tests, not real DNS
